title: Account Summary Card
description: Input contract for the Account Summary Card widget: account header fields, firmographics, owner and location, open pipeline totals, the top open opportunities, and the record URL.

accountName.title: Account Name
accountName.description: Display name of the account, shown as the card heading.

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: Industry picklist value on the account.

type.title: Account Type
type.description: Account Type picklist value, such as Customer, Prospect, or Partner. Rendered as a badge.

ownerName.title: Owner
ownerName.description: Full name of the account owner.

billingLocation.title: Location
billingLocation.description: Billing city and state or country, pre-formatted for display.

annualRevenue.title: Annual Revenue
annualRevenue.description: Annual revenue, pre-formatted as a currency string for display.

numberOfEmployees.title: Employees
numberOfEmployees.description: Number of employees on the account.

contactCount.title: Contacts
contactCount.description: Count of contacts related to the account.

openOpportunityCount.title: Open Opportunities
openOpportunityCount.description: Count of opportunities that are not closed.

openPipelineAmount.title: Open Pipeline
openPipelineAmount.description: Sum of open opportunity amounts, pre-formatted as a currency string for display.

hasOpenOpportunities.title: Has Open Opportunities
hasOpenOpportunities.description: True when at least one open opportunity exists. Controls whether the opportunity list renders.

isPipelineEmpty.title: Pipeline Is Empty
isPipelineEmpty.description: True when there are no open opportunities. Controls the empty-state callout.

opportunities.title: Top Open Opportunities
opportunities.description: Open opportunities to list on the card, typically the top few by amount.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Opportunity amount, pre-formatted as a currency string for display.

closeDate.title: Close Date
closeDate.description: Expected close date, pre-formatted for display.

accountUrl.title: Account URL
accountUrl.description: Full URL of the account record in Salesforce, used by the Open in Salesforce button.
